sentences.en: The electrical appliance must have been damaged in transit.
sentences.zh: 这电器在运输过程中可能已经损坏了。

sentences.en: All transit passangers should proceed to the "Departures Hall".
sentences.zh: 所有中转乘客都应前往‘出发大厅’。

sentences.en: Tunisia is a transit country for Algerian gas going to Italy.
sentences.zh: 突尼斯是阿尔及利亚天然气输往意大利的中转国。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：trans（变换，转移）+it（走）→转移走→运输，载运
